An unknown key comes *first*, before any key the format interprets, so a writer that appends
unknown keys by walking the original order has to move it to the end rather than leaving it in
front of `relation:root`. The relations are also out of schema order.

`relation:root` names a note with no file, which is fine: a dangling reference is a designed
state. `relation:reply_to` names a note that does exist, so a root recomputation from here has
somewhere to walk.
